model.name: Building detail 8
model.reason: Shape and structure-bound colours decoded. Both view-conditioned visibility groups are recovered, and every authored box list and group default is offered as its own inspection form because a free-orbit view has no player position to select one with. Articulated part. $054D98 installs the placing structure's X and Z scale bytes at $539CE/$539D2, $053B4A scales this record's pivot the same way, and $053D52 scales each vertex before $053D74 turns the tagged ones by $7888, so the turn belongs to the structure frame rather than to the model. Frames evidenced here: 2×-2, each offered at 8 sampled angles. $7888 free-runs, so no single frame of it is canonical.
